sources.name: Small-1
sources.prompt: Production game terrain texture, square full opaque image. Image 1 is the exact base earth texture and Image 2 is the APPROVED integrated copper-and-earth painting style. Repaint Image 1 as a coherent earth texture with NINE SMALL embedded copper exposures, one centred in EACH of the nine equal 3-by-3 subdivisions. Invisible grid: centres at x=16.67%,50%,83.33% and y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. All nine centres must visibly contain copper. Each exposure has a continuous solid copper face about 40% of ONE subdivision width and height (13% of whole image), ensuring a 30%-cell-width visible copper core centred on that cell. Surrounding broken earth, dusty transitions, cracks and soil lips are painted as one unified complete picture with the copper, like reference 2. Repaint the earth clod at each target centre INTO partly buried copper with naturally fractured earth wrapping it; no separate freestanding nugget sprites. Small copper exposures should sit flush in the earth face, have irregular silhouettes, subdued broad copper/peach facets and fine copper fragments in the immediate surrounding soil. Preserve original earth structure and colour near all invisible subdivision boundaries and around the frame. No drawn grid, seams, frames, gaps, text, labels, glow, gems, star sparkles, black crater or deep wall. Exact same orthographic view, light from upper left, brown palette and hand-painted game detail as the references. Make the nine exposures subtly varied while consistently SMALL. This entire image will be sliced into nine full opaque earth-and-copper terrain tiles. All soil in these tiles is part of the authored illustration.
